in_hebrew.name: Holcman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Holcman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'hale' (whole, healthy) and 'colm' (column, pillar), Holcman may have originated as a name for a strong, spiritual pilgrim or wanderer in medieval Europe. It may also be connected to the Latin word 'holocaus', meaning 'wholly burnt offering'.
